name: *Mute
source:
The security AI for the Mugunghwa who was created on Earth. She was the Councillor of Security, and thus in charge of the security forces of the Mugunghwa, until an incident caused things to change. Remained in charge of security even after the incident though. She's more than 1600 years old.

After the incident with the Pale Bride, many years after the first incident, she has had to spend the many years since then shut down due to damage she took.

[spoiler]She tried to overthrow the Mugunghwa Council, which she was part of, when she felt that they were jeopardizing the ship's security and stability, but she failed and her memory was wiped as a result.[/spoiler]
